raw_probability_reference.note: 2或3位玩家08:00–16:00每分钟判定，钓点倍率2.5；忽略空间、收杆、睡眠、耐久；不是完整服务器预测

assumptions.initial: 100 fish; advanced category probabilities 38/28/18/9/4/2/1; length-uniform initialization, age 0–14d
assumptions.growth: new proposal T80 1/2/4/5/7/10/14 days; birth 4cm; individual cap factor triangular .85/1/1.15
assumptions.probability: current quality selection weights, bite base, size bite shape, size escape; bamboo quality fit; catch-group fit 1
assumptions.spatial: one well-mixed candidate pool; no spot isolation or migration simulation
assumptions.time: 20 successful catches evenly spaced across 24h; no session waiting or hook occupation simulation
assumptions.replenishment: daily fill 100; stock never drops to 40 in this 20-catch scenario
assumptions.omitted: runtime overrides, species/rod group differences, rod damage, paid bait, groundbait, escapes as explicit events, sleep effects, nutrition, return fish
